C-STABILIZE-CI-INTEGRATION.Name: Integrate the verified CI recovery candidate
C-STABILIZE-CI-INTEGRATION.Summary: Integrate the completed C-CI-CD-AUDIT-FIXES implementation into the stabilization baseline, restoring change classification and its required checks without changing release versions or publishing.
C-STABILIZE-CI-INTEGRATION.ApprovalBasis: The owner approved the stabilization recovery plan on 2026-11-09, requested final implementation through a clean green main, and delegated implementation choices to the agent's recommendations.

Goals.Goal: Verify and integrate the existing CI repair rather than reimplement it.
Retain mandatory safety checks, signed-release approvals and platform coverage.

Constraints.Constraint: No release version changes, tags, deployment or publication.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No new product behavior, runtime dependency upgrade, live deployment or release authorization.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-046 CI and release workflows; M-071 checked gateway deploy; one baseline test map correction.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Fresh local command results and hosted candidate-specific required checks before main integration.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The imported workflow and gateway tests, IPC types, actionlint and GRACE assertions pass on the integration tree.
The exact outgoing candidate passes commit and push safety checks and hosted required CI before integration into main.

D-STAB-CI-01.Choice: Reuse the existing completed CI repair, including the pre-existing test module-map correction.
D-STAB-CI-01.Reason: The current main failure is change classification and the archived repair directly addresses the missing checkout and filter semantics.

D-STAB-CI-02.Choice: Sequential integration with one bounded review per exact candidate.
D-STAB-CI-02.Reason: Changes share CI and release surfaces; no repeated full-context clean-streak review is needed to verify this integration.

C-STABILIZE-CI-INTEGRATION.ExecutionEvidence: 2026-11-09: focused tests 38/38, IPC typecheck and actionlint pass. Final assertions ran all three required leaf commands with zero lint errors. Applied denotes the local implementation; exact-candidate safety and hosted CI remain mandatory before main integration. No version, tag or publication changed.
